zh.ABSTRACT: 本项目使用作者的 OpenHands/SWE-QA 流程、发布权重和 GLM-4.6，在固定 Streamlink 八题上完成三条件、三次执行，共 72 项。完整观测、剪枝、剪枝加精确恢复的平均评分为 8.63、9.27、9.13，累计 tokens 为 112.8K、131.0K、139.8K。剪枝组相对完整观测增加 16.1% tokens，与论文减少 54.4% 的结果呈现不同方向；差异主要由剪枝触发频率、长输出和后续多轮调查解释。主要修改是任务级原始观测存储和有界行范围恢复。另一个 72 项固定上下文测试中，精确匹配从剪后观测的 3/24 提升到可恢复观测的 24/24，同时增加上下文开销。结果支持恢复证据的能力，并显示读取策略决定最终的质量与成本权衡。
zh.CASE_ANALYSIS:
剪枝组在 10/24 个任务中实际调用 skimmer，共 16 次，将这些输出的 268,659 个源 tokens 保留为 63,009 个，压缩 76.5%。恢复组在 4/24 个任务中剪枝。自主选择使各组读代码的路径也发生变化。

按每题三次均值选择 token 降幅最大的 q30 和增幅最大的 q11。q30 的完整／剪枝均值为 249.8K／167.6K；第 1 次执行中，page.py 的 54,349 个源 tokens 被剪到 13,107，最大输入从 40,427 降到 18,258，API 调用为 11／10。长文件压缩在这一轨迹中转化为累计节省。

q11 的完整／剪枝均值为 358.2K／520.4K，三次剪枝组均未填写关注问题。第 3 次执行对整个 CDP 目录递归搜索 from_json 及事件解析，持续读取完整结果；最大输入达到 43,299，累计 826,860 tokens，完整组对应为 15,306 和 305,129。这个差异反映工具选择及调查路径。事后逐题影响检查中，移除 q11 后其余七题的 token 差为 −2.4K；主统计仍保留全部八题，95% 区间跨越增减两个方向。
zh.JUDGE_ANALYSIS: 评分提升集中于 q41：完整／剪枝均值为 5.00／8.53。题目要求定位 TestIO 的 test_load_data；完整组答案先讲 Cache 实现，再提测试，剪枝组直接定位测试方法。第 1 次完整答案得 4.6 分，虽包含正确的 dirty 机制，仍偏离了问题的定位重点。保留原始评分；事后移除 q41 后，评分差从 +0.63 变为 +0.22，说明单题与回答粒度对均值影响显著。
zh.CONCLUSIONS:
**复现效果。** 已运行作者工具链并验证长观测压缩行为。在本八题子集中，剪枝将实际处理的源文本压缩 76.5%，最终累计 tokens 增加 16.1%，评分提高 0.63。论文的整体节省幅度在本地样本中表现为不同的资源权衡，q11 的长调查轨迹对均值影响最大。

**修改效果。** 精确恢复在固定目标变化测试中把正确数从 3/24 提升到 24/24；自主 QA 中，相对剪枝组 tokens 增加 6.8%，平均评分变化 −0.13，评分差区间跨零。轨迹同时呈现补回缺失证据与重建整个文件两种行为。

**下一步。** 扩大题目覆盖，并在开发集上明确恢复预算、索引和停止策略，再冻结测试。XJ13 可沿用任务级存储接口，进一步比较结构化记录的投影与切片，测量证据覆盖、重复读取及总交互成本。

en.ABSTRACT: We run the released SWE-Pruner/OpenHands pipeline and checkpoint with GLM-4.6 on eight fixed Streamlink questions, three conditions and three executions: 72 completed cells. Full, pruned and recoverable observations score 8.63, 9.27 and 9.13, using 112.8K, 131.0K and 139.8K cumulative tokens. Pruning increases tokens by 16.1%, contrasting with the paper's 54.4% decrease. Activation, long outputs and subsequent investigation explain the local discrepancy. Our isolated modification adds task-scoped original-observation storage and bounded exact range recovery. A separate 72-cell goal-shift experiment improves exact matches from 3/24 after pruning to 24/24 with recovery, with additional context cost. Evidence accessibility is demonstrated; retrieval decisions determine the end-to-end trade-off.
en.CASE_ANALYSIS:
Pruning activates in 10/24 tasks: 16 calls reduce 268,659 source tokens to 63,009, a 76.5% reduction. Recovery activates pruning in 4/24 tasks. Autonomous choices also change repository-reading paths.

We inspect q30 and q11, the largest mean token decrease and increase. For q30, full/pruned means are 249.8K/167.6K. In repetition 1, page.py shrinks from 54,349 source tokens to 13,107; peak input falls from 40,427 to 18,258, with 11/10 API calls. Local compression translates into cumulative savings on this trajectory.

For q11, full/pruned means are 358.2K/520.4K; all three pruning-condition executions omit the focus question. Repetition 3 recursively searches the CDP directory for deserializers and event parsing, repeatedly carrying full results. Peak input reaches 43,299 and total tokens 826,860, versus 15,306 and 305,129 for full observations. This reflects tool selection and investigation paths. A post-hoc influence check omitting q11 gives a −2.4K token difference across the other seven questions. Primary statistics retain all eight; the token interval spans both directions.
en.JUDGE_ANALYSIS: The score gain concentrates in q41: full/pruned means are 5.00/8.53. The question asks for TestIO.test_load_data; full answers foreground production Cache logic, while pruned answers directly locate the test. The first full answer scores 4.6 despite explaining the dirty mechanism correctly. Original scores remain unchanged. Omitting q41 in a post-hoc influence check changes the score difference from +0.63 to +0.22, illustrating sensitivity to one question and answer granularity.
en.CONCLUSIONS:
**Reproduction.** The released pipeline executes and compresses long observations. In this eight-question subset, source text processed by the skimmer shrinks 76.5%, while cumulative tokens increase 16.1% and score rises 0.63. The local resource trade-off differs from the paper's aggregate saving; q11's investigation trajectory has the largest influence.

**Modification.** Exact recovery improves goal-shift correctness from 3/24 to 24/24. Autonomous QA instead uses 6.8% more tokens than pruning and changes score by −0.13, with a score interval spanning zero. Traces show both missing-evidence retrieval and full-file reconstruction.

**Next steps.** Broaden question coverage and define retrieval budgets, indexing and stopping policies on development data before freezing evaluation. XJ13 can reuse task-scoped storage and compare structured-record projection and slicing through evidence coverage, repeated reads and total interaction cost.
